# Pinoy Adventurista

> > Your comprehensive Filipino travel companion featuring DIY itineraries, budget guides, and destination insights across the Philippines and beyond.

Pinoy Adventurista is a travel blog offering detailed guides for Filipino travelers exploring destinations worldwide, with special focus on Philippine tourist spots, Southeast Asian adventures, and practical travel tips. The site features comprehensive itineraries, accommodation reviews, budget breakdowns, and travel requirements for popular destinations from Boracay to Tokyo.

## Key Topics

- Philippines travel destinations
- DIY travel itineraries
- Budget travel tips
- Boracay and beach resorts
- Baguio and Sagada highlands
- Manila and Metro Manila
- Cebu Pacific promos
- AGODA hotel bookings
- Tokyo and Japan travel
- Hong Kong Disneyland
- Southeast Asia adventures
- Travel requirements and protocols
- Bohol and Panglao resorts
- Tacloban and Leyte tourism
- Adventure activities and hiking

- [3 DAYS IN BORACAY: Ultimate Boracay Itinerary + Things to Do & Where to Stay!](https://www.pinoyadventurista.com/2021/08/boracay-itinerary-tourist-spots-things-to-do.html): 3-day Boracay itinerary with activities, accommodations, airport info
- [BEST BEACH RESORTS IN BOHOL + Resorts with Pool, Affordable Hotels, Cheap Hostels and More!](https://www.pinoyadventurista.com/2016/10/list-top-best-recommended-hotels-resorts-in-panglao-bohol.html): Bohol & Panglao accommodation guide: beach resorts, budget hotels
- [TACLOBAN ITINERARY: 10 Best TACLOBAN TOURIST SPOTS and Things to Do (Leyte Travel Guide Blog for First-timers)](https://www.pinoyadventurista.com/2013/08/10-things-to-do-in-tacloban-city-leyte.html): Tacloban first-timer guide: top 10 tourist spots in Eastern Visayas
